0022600086.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Washington Wizards host the Milwaukee Bucks, and the Wizards will be without Jamir Watkins (knee) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip), who are both out. Washington won three of four meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 109-99 home win over Milwaukee on January 29, 2026. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Wizards a 65% chance to win.
